tasks.short: Prepare and submit plant forms and reports

steps.what: Find and read the actual compliance, operational or safety report requirements and current form for the relevant plant and reporting period in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual plant and report due
Existing authoritative requirements and current forms
outputs: Actual applicable form, reporting scope and source requirements

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual operational, compliance and safety source records for the reporting period in the plant logbook {OPS_SYSTEM}, resolving missing readings or event facts with the actual source owners.
inputs: Actual report scope from s1
Existing timestamped readings, field records and event logs
outputs: Actual verified source values, event facts and explicit gaps

steps.what: Enter the verified operational values and source identifiers into the actual report form draft in {DOCS} using the native logbook report export.
inputs: Actual verified values and event identifiers from s2
Exact current form and field mappings from s1
outputs: Draft populated report fields with source references and unresolved gaps

steps.what: Write the actual required operational, compliance or safety narrative, explaining real exceptions, events and limitations within the report draft {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual populated report from s3
Verified event facts and gaps from s2
Applicable requirements from s1
outputs: Complete report draft including actual narrative and limitations

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final report against original readings, units, period, event records, applicable requirements and the exact authorised submission destination.
inputs: Complete actual report from s4
Original sources and requirements
Existing reporting delegation
outputs: Exact checked final report and authorised destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked final report in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact completed report checked in s5

steps.what: Submit the exact checked final compliance report to the designated authority through {GOV_PORTAL} within the operator's existing delegation.
inputs: Unchanged final report saved in s6
Exact destination and delegation checked in s5
outputs: Actual submitted final report and portal receipt

tasks.design: Configure current requirements/form views and native logbook-to-form export. Retain real source verification, exception narrative and completed-report checking, with separate final save and submission. No model is required for known field copying.
tasks.previous_blocker: Remaining manual transfer of actual logbook values to repeated report fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source-linked report exports and field mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Missing or suspect plant data, actual event interpretation and reporting authority.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what the actual records support and qualify unresolved facts.

ambition.what: No automatic compliance assertion or plant-control action.

tasks.altitude: Less real report transcription with evidence and submission responsibility retained.

reach.learn: Preserve units, time periods and unresolved data gaps

evidence.claim: Native operational logbook exports can populate repeated report fields while source and narrative validation remain human work.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured plant-reporting baselines. Compliance, operational and safety forms use their actual requirements; the shown external compliance submission is a branch with an actually authorised operator. Internal-only reports use their existing internal destination, with no external submission invented.

Existing instrumentation and field operators produce real timestamped readings and event notes through unchanged monitoring/capture work. The focal operator retrieves and verifies actual values and missing data in s2. No free new field-capture feed; absent structured sources require manual form entry and reduce gain.

Test native export/mapping before code. s3 replaces actual remaining manual re-key only; existing automatic report runtime earns zero new saving. No saving on narrative judgment, original-source verification or final checks.

Ordinary completed-report checking supplies requested save/submission gates without extra self-approval labour. Higher-authority sign-off, if required, remains its existing separate process before actual submission and must be priced from the actual arrangement. Revised content or destination requires renewed final checks. Both 1% save and 1% submission remain fully retained with no saving.
research_questions: Does native export reproduce the current form's values, units and periods and leave missing data visibly unresolved?

already_counted.description: Residual requirements reading, actual source verification, narrative writing, complete checks, save and submission remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain actual form mappings, source links and export checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed report checked in s5
Unchanged final report and authorised destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.40+25=31 gross less 2 mapping upkeep gives 29. Zero if report fields and source views already operate natively; no save/send saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Trace circuitry and assess electrical compliance

steps.what: Find and read current electrical drawings and applicable code or law source material for the actual plant circuitry in the controlled engineering-document system {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual electrical system and authorised scope
Existing controlled drawings and applicable source requirements
outputs: Actual current drawing set and applicable original requirements

steps.what: Trace actual electrical circuitry within the operator's competence and existing authorised site controls, comparing physical identifiers and connections with the current drawings.
inputs: Actual electrical equipment and conditions
Current drawings and authorised scope from s1
outputs: Actual traced circuit observations and discrepancies

steps.what: Evaluate actual traced circuitry against applicable codes or laws, distinguishing verified compliance evidence, discrepancies and matters requiring the responsible electrical specialist.
inputs: Actual trace observations from s2
Original applicable requirements and drawings from s1
outputs: Actual bounded assessment and unresolved specialist questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual traced circuit identifiers, observations, source requirements and assessment limits in the existing electrical inspection record {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual observations from s2
Actual assessment and questions from s3
outputs: Complete checked actual electrical inspection record

steps.what: Save the exact checked electrical inspection record in the inspection-record system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact completed record checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure controlled drawing/requirement views. Keep actual physical tracing, code applicability and assessment with the qualified operator and existing specialists. Write actual inspection findings separately from physical work, then save them unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some repeated navigation of current engineering sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing revision and asset views.
tasks.still_hard: Actual circuit condition, drawing discrepancies and scope of competence.
tasks.human_edge: Direct physical observation and accountable technical assessment.

ambition.what: No automatic electrical certification, switching or energisation.

tasks.altitude: Small source-retrieval improvement; physical technical work remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep drawing assumptions separate from physical observations

evidence.claim: Native drawing views can reduce revision navigation without proving physical electrical compliance.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional active-work estimates, not measured electrical-inspection baselines. Actual tracing, assessment and the existing written inspection record are included. No specific operating instructions or legal thresholds are invented.

Existing engineering owners maintain drawings and applicable requirements through unchanged work. The operator retrieves sources in s1, produces real trace observations in s2 and actual bounded conclusions in s3 before capturing them in s4. Missing or conflicting drawings require actual clarification; no inferred as-built connections.

Native source views come first. Existing work permits, competence limits and electrical controls remain fully in actual work, rather than new software approval stages. No physical switching, repair or energisation is silently automated.

No saving on physical tracing, applicability decisions, actual new inspection content or the short same-system save. Ordinary completed-record checking supplies the requested save gate without extra self-approval labour; changes invalidate it. Already configured views produce zero new gain.
research_questions: Do source views retrieve the applicable current drawing without treating it as proof of physical compliance?

already_counted.description: Residual original-source reading, physical tracing, actual assessment, factual record and save remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed electrical inspection record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*.30=3 gross less .5 upkeep gives 2.5. Zero if drawing navigation is already configured; no save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and interpret the actual current regulatory and permit requirements applicable to the well field, selecting the approved parameter, unit, period and limit rules in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual well field and reporting period
Existing authoritative requirements and approved rule register
outputs: Actual applicable versioned requirements and comparison rules

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual well field monitoring data from the historian {DATA_PLATFORM}, checking sample locations, timestamps, parameter identifiers, units, quality flags and missing results against original field or laboratory records.
inputs: Actual applicable scope from s1
Existing timestamped monitoring results and original field/laboratory records
outputs: Actual verified comparison dataset and explicit data-quality issues

steps.what: Compare actual verified well field monitoring results with the selected approved parameter, unit, period and limit rules in the historian compliance view {DATA_PLATFORM}.
inputs: Actual verified dataset and quality issues from s2
Actual versioned comparison rules from s1
outputs: Draft source-linked rule matches, exceedances and unresolved data flags

steps.what: Verify whether the actual monitoring data conforms to applicable requirements by reviewing original evidence, flagged exceedances, missing data and rule applicability, resolving exceptions with responsible monitoring specialists.
inputs: Actual draft comparisons from s3
Original monitoring results and requirements
Actual specialist clarifications
outputs: Operator's actual conformance assessment and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Write and check the actual well-field conformance findings, rule versions, source references and unresolved exceptions in the monitoring-review record {OPS_SYSTEM}.
inputs: Actual final assessment from s4
Actual original results and rule versions from s1-s2

steps.what: Save the exact checked well-field monitoring-review record in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
inputs: Exact completed review record checked in s5

tasks.design: Configure native versioned monitoring-rule comparisons in the existing historian. Retain original-data verification, requirement interpretation, real exception resolution and actual conformance findings. Save the completed checked review record separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: A remaining manual comparison of actual monitoring values with known approved requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing structured monitoring data and versioned native parameter/unit/period rules.
tasks.still_hard: Data quality, changing applicability and incomplete monitoring evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a numerical match from evidence of overall conformance.

ambition.what: No automatic compliance certification, plant action or regulator notification.

tasks.altitude: Less literal threshold comparison while substantive verification remains accountable.

reach.learn: Preserve source quality flags and applicable rule versions

evidence.claim: Native historian rules can compare structured monitoring values with approved limits while missing data and applicability remain human review tasks.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional active-work estimates, not measured monitoring baselines. s3 replaces actual remaining manual rule comparison only; existing automatic rules or historian runtime have zero new saving.

Existing field staff, laboratories and instrumentation produce real sample ids, locations, timestamps, parameter values, units and quality flags through unchanged monitoring/capture work. That work receives no saving here. The focal operator retrieves and verifies actual data in s2; missing structured fields require manual resolution or manual comparison, not fabricated results.

Existing regulatory/permit owners maintain the approved versioned rule register. The operator selects actual applicable rules in s1 and checks applicability in s4. Native configuration comes first; any unknown unit, period, parameter or result is unresolved rather than silently treated as conforming.

Actual review findings are written separately in s5. No saving on substantive verification, new factual findings or same-system save. The ordinary completed-record check supplies the requested save gate without added self-approval labour; edits require rechecking. Reporting/submission is handled by the separate prepare-and-submit task, with no duplicate saving here.
research_questions: Do native comparisons reproduce verified manual results and flag missing/invalid data without issuing a blanket conformance claim?

already_counted.description: Residual requirements reading, actual source-data verification, exception assessment, factual findings and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain approved rule versions, data mappings and comparison checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed actual monitoring-review record checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.40+30=36 gross less 3 rule/mapping upkeep gives 33. Zero if rule comparison is already native runtime; no save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less report transcription and literal monitoring comparison, with plant and compliance decisions retained by responsible operators.
role.ambitious_version: An operator who spends less effort copying existing values and retains direct responsibility for actual evidence, exceptions and authorised plant work.
